rubric_freeze.note: Hash of docs/ASSESSOR_RUBRIC.md as it stood at freeze time, before the freeze banner was prepended. Validation runs record this value.

gate.status: PROVISIONAL — set by the research owner 2026-09-12, before any validation run
gate.what_this_validates: NOT that INDIRECT matches expert judgment -- no domain experts are available. It validates something narrower and still useful: that the category is operationally coherent, reproducible across independent assessors, grounded in the supplied text, and not manufacturing signal. Passing makes the assessor PROVISIONALLY validated, never 'settled'.
gate.known_weakness: Only one model deployment is available (gpt-4.1-kasia), so the two judges differ in prompt and reasoning scaffold but share a model. Same-model agreement has correlated errors and is materially weaker evidence than cross-model agreement. This is why the grounding and adversarial criteria carry the weight rather than agreement alone.

criterion_1_boundary_reproducibility.statistic: agreement between two independent blinded assessors on the three-way judgment, restricted to cases where at least one said indirect or no_evidence (direct cases excluded)
criterion_1_boundary_reproducibility.note: Reproducibility, NOT human validity. Passing does not validate the construct.

criterion_2_direction_reproducibility.statistic: agreement between the two assessors on direction (supports/contradicts/none)

criterion_3_grounded_and_independently_r.statistic: among cases v2 newly promotes out of no_evidence: the fraction that carry a complete chain whose supporting span is verbatim in the supplied abstract, with no unsupported intermediate fact, AND that a second independent assessor also calls evidential
criterion_3_grounded_and_independently_r.note: Stricter than the 0.75 that would have been used against human adjudication, because consensus between automated judges is weaker evidence.

criterion_4_negative_control_mismatched_.statistic: P(informative | proposition paired with a randomly mismatched abstract)
criterion_4_negative_control_mismatched_.note: The strongest single check available without experts. If the assessor calls 20-30% of mismatched abstracts indirect evidence, the rubric is too permissive regardless of how well the judges agree with each other.

adversarial_controls.mismatched_abstract: proposition x unrelated abstract -> should collapse to no_evidence
adversarial_controls.swapped_record: supporting record exchanged between two propositions
adversarial_controls.negated_proposition: proposition negated -> DIRECTION should flip; informativeness staying put while direction does not move means the assessor is not reading the claim
adversarial_controls.span_removed: the sentence supporting the intermediate fact deleted from the abstract -> an indirect judgment should disappear

what_passing_permits: evidence_assess_v2 may replace v1, marked PROVISIONALLY validated
the 18-row nested development sweep becomes worth running

paper_wording.do_not_claim: The assessor accurately distinguishes indirect evidence from merely related literature.
paper_wording.claim_instead: We operationalize indirect evidence using an explicit intermediate-fact chain and validate the assessor through independent-model agreement, source-grounding checks, and adversarial controls.
paper_wording.note: Weaker but precise. With same-model judges, 'independent-model agreement' must be downgraded to 'independent-prompt agreement' unless a second model is obtained.

same_model_caveat: Both judges run on one deployment; they differ in prompt and reasoning scaffold only.
